summary_en: 400,000 shares to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-14 at ¥3,020/share (closing price 2026-08-13); ¥1,360M upper limit; results to be disclosed after market open.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares via Off-Hours Trading Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-13, Mitani Corporation's board resolved to acquire 400,000 of its own shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition was executed on 2026-08-14 at market open (08:45 JST) at ¥3,020 per share, the closing price from the prior trading day. The acquisition carries a total upper limit of ¥1,360M. The order was to be executed only during the specified trading window; results were to be disclosed immediately after the 08:45 window closed. The filing notes that the share count will not be adjusted and that partial or complete non-execution is possible depending on market conditions.
